decisive_test: Per class, one mechanical leg the compiler re-derives from the canonical and refuses on: instrument_names_code — the record's sole 2020 ancestor is the code the Perpres names and the inheritance is whole (sebagian false); statute_item_by_title — the statute item's operative noun is in the record's title; government_activity — the code sits under 84 or the title carries «Pemerintah» as a word, AND the rule's whole canonical population is either an item or a named exclusion; non_commercial_institutional — the title names the international-body class. Every item must ALREADY read TERTUTUP/0.
what_this_rests_on_and_does_not_prove: Only 11010 and 11020 are named 5-digit by an instrument. 01287, 92000, the 54 government codes and 99000 are TITLE-DERIVED: no instrument maps them to 5-digit codes, and the basis string says so. The dossier's Pasal 2(1a) reading (the open list is commercial fields, so state activities and international bodies are not investable fields) is a reading, recorded as such.
